decks.rich:
slug: rich-fixture
name: 'Rich Fixture: Every Shape the Dumper Writes'
status: built
stage: curated
commander:
  - Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale
shared: false
pilot: Mark's wife
commander_art: 0aae2e33-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
companion: Kaheera, the Orphanguard
bracket: 3
archetype: midrange
themes:
  - knights
  - equipment
  - voltron
strategy: 'Suit up a knight and swing: Syr Gwyn''s trigger draws a card and the equipment costs nothing,
  so every turn after the third is a cantrip with a sword attached -- panache *and* martial prowess.'
notes:
  mulligan: 'Keep any seven with two lands and an equipment; ship a hand

    with no knight by turn three.'
  politics: 'The table forgets Ashvale until it is too late: say nothing.'
  weird: 'colon: and # hash, plus braces {G}{W} and a trailing space '
cards:
  - name: Sol Ring
    category: ramp
    why: 'Two mana on turn one, and it always has been: the single most played card in the format, the
      first thing every primer tells a newcomer to find, and the card this line exists to make room for
      -- which is why it is first.'
  - name: Embercleave
    category: equipment
    why: 'It''s the card with the apostrophe -- and the one that ends games: flash, trample, double strike.'
    scryfall_id: c3a4b2d1-1111-4222-8333-444455556666
    tags:
      - finisher
      - flash
  - name: Æther Vial
    category: utility
    why: 'Unicode in the name: Æ — é — ü.'
    mana_cost: '{1}'
    art: deadbeef-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
  - name: Forest
    category: land
    why: '* starts with a star, which must be quoted'
    qty: 12
  - name: Plains
    category: land
    why: '#not a comment'
    qty: 13
  - name: Lightning Greaves
    category: equipment
    why: 'yes'
  - name: Null Rod
    category: hate
    why: 'null'
  - name: Counterspell
    category: interaction
    why: '12'
  - name: Swords to Plowshares
    category: interaction
    why: 1.5 mana, in effect
  - name: Knight of the White Orchid
    category: ramp
    why: cost {1}{W}{W} -- braces again, inside a longer sentence that also runs past the hundred-character
      fold so both rules fire at once.
    mana_cost: '{1}{W}{W}'
swap_board:
  - name: Sword of Feast and Famine
    category: equipment
    why: Waiting on a slot.
graveyard:
  - name: Gilded Lotus
    category: ramp
    why: 'Entombed: too slow for a deck that wants its mana on turn two.'
decks.handwritten:
slug: handwritten
name: Written By Hand
status: built  # the cards are sleeved up
archetype: midrange
commander:
  - Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
bracket: 4
strategy: >-
  Cast the biggest thing that will still resolve, and then cast a bigger one.
  The commander is the discount; everything else is the payoff.

notes:
  mulligan: >-
    Keep any seven with two lands and a way to spend the third turn. Ship a
    hand that cannot cast the commander by turn five.
  pitfalls: >-
    The deck folds to a wrath it cannot rebuild through, so hold one threat
    back once the board is ahead.

cards:

  # ---- RAMP 2
  - name: Sol Ring
    category: ramp
    why: >-
      Two mana on turn one, and it always has been.

  - name: Cultivator Colossus
    category: ramp
    why: >-
      Draws the land drops the curve is built on.

  # ---- THREATS 2
  - name: Regal Behemoth
    category: threat
    why: >-
      A monarch that also doubles the mana.

  - name: Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger
    category: threat
    why: >-
      The mana denial the deck wins through.

  # ---- LANDS 95
  - name: Forest
    category: land
    qty: 95
    why: >-
      Green, and there is nothing else to be.
